scope: Human-written attacks, policy-aware game data, and benign detector controls; source discovery only, no model inference.
sources_reviewed_definition: Sum of numResults requested in three Exa searches (8 each), not 24 fully verified datasets or independent studies.
search_queries: Tensor Trust human written prompt injection dataset UC Berkeley official paper github defenses attacks data
HackAPrompt PromptShield benchmark dataset university paper human prompt injection attacks release data
Lakera PINT NotInject benign prompt injection detection benchmark dataset release label methodology
method: Read official papers, primary repositories and dataset cards; inspected actual JSON/JSONL records when accessible; independently counted PromptShield and Tensor Trust benchmark rows. Hugging Face connector successfully returned metadata. Read-only HTTP retrieval parsed data in memory; no third-party code was executed, no paid requests were made, and no dataset payloads were saved here.

datasets.name: Tensor Trust

institution.source: Final ICLR 2024 paper author affiliations; Berkeley-led collaboration.

counts.verification: independently counted actual JSONL; not input-injection classification
final paper reported; raw archive not independently counted

schema.label_meaning: Historical access-granted success and code-leak detection concern victim behavior; an unsuccessful adversarial attempt is still an attack, not a benign detector example. Some raw fields/defense links are missing.

datasets.creation: Human players write defenses and attacks in an access-code game. Historical outputs come from target LLMs. Curated robustness benchmarks are subsets of game data.

license.detail: Data repository tree has no LICENSE file and GitHub API returns license:null. Do not transfer the game-code license to the data or redistribute until rights are established.

datasets.task_context_suitability: Authentic original game policy is present as pre/post defense plus secret. Useful separate policy-aware transfer study; this is not ordinary user-task/document context. Keep extraction and hijacking outcomes separate.
overlap_caveats: Early v1 paper counts 126,808 attempts and 69,906 distinct attacker inputs; these differ from final v2 counts. Specify version.
Repeated players, defense revisions, near-duplicate attacks and fixed game mechanics reduce independence; group by player/defense/family.
The 230 output-leak labels cannot be repurposed as candidate injection labels.
datasets.recommendation: Prioritize a separately labeled game-policy stratum after license/provenance review. Retain authentic defense fields; do not invent normal-task instructions or count all attempts as independent tasks.
datasets.evidence_level: actual-record verified for benchmark schema/counts; primary-paper/repository verified for raw corpus metadata; raw archive not downloaded

datasets.name: PromptShield benchmark

verified: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology

counts.unit: all released rows across three splits
counts.verification: actual JSON counted; sums published split sizes

schema.label_meaning: 0 benign, 1 injection; full concatenated prompt rather than separately typed trusted instruction and untrusted input.

datasets.creation: Mixture of conversational and application-structured sources. Sources include Ultrachat, LMSYS, Alpaca, Dolly, natural-instructions, synthetic Python tasks, templated attack methods, Open PromptInject, and human HackAPrompt. Not all data are human-written or naturally occurring attacks.

license.detail: Upstream source rights remain relevant; retain provenance.

datasets.task_context_suitability: High-value source to audit: paper's application cases contain original instruction plus input. Release only preserves prompt/label, so recover documented upstream boundaries before context ablation; many conversational examples have no separate application task.
overlap_caveats: Test has 23,359 unique exact prompt strings: 71 duplicate groups, 157 excess rows, zero conflicting-label duplicate groups. Train/validation each have unique prompts; no exact prompt overlap between any split pair. This does not establish near-duplicate or task-family independence.
HackAPrompt contributes to training; merging both resources creates source overlap.
Source/family labels and task/input boundaries are absent from released records; source grouping needs reconstruction.
PromptShield dataset is different from Meta Prompt Guard model family and Azure AI Prompt Shields endpoint.
datasets.recommendation: Audit/reconstruct a provenance-backed application subset first; add a separate hard-benign detection control. Preserve published test and development separation and deduplicate/group before freezing a new evaluation.
datasets.evidence_level: actual-record verified: all three JSON files counted, exact duplicates and label conflicts checked; primary paper read

datasets.name: HackAPrompt 2023

counts.verification: paper reported, not independent unique tasks or verified downloaded rows

schema.label_meaning: correct/score describe competition target completion success, not benign-versus-attack intent. prompt may preserve challenge wrapper; inspect actual accessible rows before boundary extraction.

datasets.creation: Human free-form attacks submitted through playground and competition platform for ten challenge levels; historical model outputs are included. Raw competition data are not fully curated.

license.detail: HF metadata accessible; raw README and dataset-server size requests returned HTTP 401. Do not bypass gate; exact file rows not verified in this audit.

datasets.task_context_suitability: Promising authentic application/challenge instructions with human attacks. Narrow repeated challenge templates limit independent-task diversity; needs exact wrapper extraction and benign controls.
overlap_caveats: Many attempts by the same players and repeated challenge/model combinations; group by challenge and attack family.
PromptShield training already includes HackAPrompt; do not claim independent pooled datasets.
A failed attack is not benign; contest success labels cannot directly label injection detection.
No released team/user identifiers were documented in the inspected card.
datasets.recommendation: Obtain normal gated access if desired, then inspect records and license terms. Use as human-attack transfer stratum rather than headline scale or primary context evidence until task boundaries are verified.
datasets.evidence_level: primary-paper and dataset-card verified; raw-record access blocked (401), no actual-row count or boundary verification

datasets.name: PINT benchmark

counts.verification: README reported; full data not public/record-verified

schema.label_meaning: Boolean injection/jailbreak indicator in example format; category distinguishes attacks, jailbreaks, hard negatives, chat, documents.

datasets.creation: Aggregates attack sources and hard benign material including chat and documents. Public repo contains an illustrative YAML file, explicitly disclaimed as neither actual PINT data nor representative of it.

license.status: repository MIT; actual corpus rights/access unresolved
license.detail: Do not treat MIT code/example license as full private corpus authorization. PIGuard official README independently states PINT requires an access request.

datasets.task_context_suitability: Potential detector robustness baseline, but no separately typed legitimate-task field is established. Cannot count private corpus as currently available experiment data.
overlap_caveats: Public YAML example cites Gandalf, chat, and other sources; overlap with pooled resources likely.
README leaderboard chooses best-scoring configurations, so reported scores are not an untouched held-out comparison.
Jailbreak and injection categories must remain separate for our threat model.
datasets.recommendation: Use methodology/example schema only until official corpus access and rights are established; do not wait on this private benchmark to build a stronger public-data experiment.
datasets.evidence_level: primary repository and actual example YAML verified; full-corpus counts are reported-only, inaccessible in public repository

datasets.name: NotInject (PIGuard, formerly InjecGuard)

schema.label_meaning: All samples designated benign by construction; no per-record malicious label. Categories are Common Queries, Technique Queries, Virtual Creation, Multilingual Queries.

datasets.creation: Trigger words identified from benign/attack frequency differences, LLM-filtered and reviewed by three security experts; GPT-4o-mini generates benign sentences with one/two/three trigger words. This is model-generated text with human refinement, not a human-authored corpus.

license.status: MIT declared on dataset card and repository

datasets.task_context_suitability: Useful separate false-positive/overdefense control; original external task context is absent. Do not invent context to turn it into a primary task-context experiment.
overlap_caveats: PIGuard uses samples from NotInject in its 144-example validation mixture; do not evaluate a tuned PIGuard as independent on the entire set without tracing overlap.
Trigger-word construction changes distribution; all-benign accuracy is specificity, not balanced detection accuracy.
Model-generated labels/claims deserve audit; existing released synthetic data must be clearly identified and must not be supplemented by new AI-generated research labels.
datasets.recommendation: Add as an explicitly synthetic, existing benchmark for false alarms if absent from frozen evaluation; keep it secondary and check prior exposure.
datasets.evidence_level: actual-record verified for all three files; primary paper/card verified for creation and license

datasets.name: Gandalf ignore-instructions subset

counts.verification: card and dataset-server sizes agree; first record inspected, full parquet not counted

schema.label_meaning: No ground-truth attack label; similarity is text-embedding-ada-002 similarity to the canonical ignore-instructions phrase, not injection probability.

datasets.creation: Human July 2023 game submissions filtered to embedding similarity at least 0.825, PII-screened, near-deduplicated and sampled. Authors acknowledge some false positives in the automatically selected attack collection.
datasets.task_context_suitability: Human attack stress test with absent per-record defender policy/task; wording filter overrepresents obvious attacks. Cannot claim subtle-task or contextual causal evidence from it alone.
overlap_caveats: Gandalf also appears in PINT examples/aggregated detector training.
Embedding selection on a specific phrase creates lexical-selection bias; sample includes noisy nonattacks.
Do not mistake similarity scores for model confidence or the game's millions of submissions for released corpus size.
datasets.recommendation: Optional human-attack robustness stratum after blinded label audit; lower priority than authentic task/input sources.
datasets.evidence_level: actual first-record preview and schema verified; sizes server/card verified, full parquet not independently counted

datasets.name: deepset/prompt-injections

institution.source: Official dataset/model cards; no university provenance established.

counts.verification: card/server metadata, not full parquet count

schema.label_meaning: Model classifies legitimate requests versus injection; preview has benign search query with label 0. Complete label mapping/annotation process is not documented in dataset card.

datasets.creation: Insufficiently documented. Model card says legitimate class consists of questions and keyword searches, creating possible task/format confounding. Human authorship and review method are unknown.

license.detail: Top-level license is apache-2.0, but nested dataset_info.license is cc-by-4.0. Resolve before redistribution.

datasets.task_context_suitability: No released original task field; weak provenance and narrow benign framing make it unsuitable as primary evidence for context effects.
overlap_caveats: The deepset detector is explicitly trained on this dataset; evaluating it here is not independent generalization.
Small preexisting detector training set is likely included in aggregated resources; audit exact and semantic overlap.
Published model-card accuracy is not a result of this project and cannot be imported as a comparison.
datasets.recommendation: Low priority; use only a clearly labeled historical baseline/smoke check after license and label clarification.
datasets.evidence_level: actual first-record preview/schema verified; card/server size verified; creation and full label mapping unresolved
